content:
eve: quick alert 1: validator v2.1 is rejecting a batch of fncalls to `image-ocr` and fallback to `image-ocr-lite` isn't triggering.

ram: saw that. logs show schema errors like "pages: expected array, got int" then fallback decision=NO_MATCH.

eve: example: 
``
2025-03-20T09:05:12Z WARN invoke.reject tool=image-ocr req=rb-xy123 reason="pages: expected array, got int"
2025-03-20T09:05:13Z WARN routing.fallback req=rb-xy123 candidate=image-ocr-lite decision=NO_MATCH reason="accepts_variants=false"
```

ops-bot: validator-service:v2.1 rolled to canary slice vs-canary-5 at 2025-03-20T08:50.

ram: root cause: catalog flag `accepts_variants=false` for the lite model. product set that to avoid silent fallbacks.

product-ux: customers will see 400s instead of downgraded runs. agree we should flip flag back and add `validation_mode` to traces so console explains canary behavior.

telemetry: metrics: validator.rejects up 4.8% and routing.fallback.no_match up 110 in last 15m for image-ocr.

ram: plan: 1) flip accepts_variants=true for image-ocr-lite (ops) 2) patch dashboard traces with validation_mode label (product) 3) schedule permissive coercion in validator v2.2 (eng).

eve: ops, please flip and tag with revert label. i'll mute the current schema.rejects alert for canary slices until telemetry is split.

ops-bot: catalog publish success id=mc-802 version=2025-03-20T09:12.

telemetry: after publish, fallback.decisions now show candidate=image-ocr-lite decision=ACCEPTED and rejects trending back down.

product-ux: filing PX-5009 to add validation_mode and a short help tooltip explaining fallback flags.

eve: thanks all. follow-ups: alert split by canary/stable, sample rejected payloads (PII redacted), validator coercion ticket.
